description: The bar chart illustrates the macro F-score performance of two models, RECA and another model (represented by the orange bars), across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the Macro F-score, ranging from 0 to 1 with major gridlines at intervals of 0.1. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by frequency. For the High frequency category, the RECA model (light pink bar) achieved a score of 0.837, while the other model (orange bar) achieved a score of 0.877. In the Medium frequency category, RECA scored 0.538 and the other model scored 0.609. For the Low frequency category, RECA scored 0.114 and the other model scored 0.224. The legend indicates that the light pink bars correspond to RECA and the orange bars represent the other model. The chart shows that the other model consistently outperforms RECA across all frequency levels, with the performance gap being most pronounced in the Low frequency category.
